benchmark_basis: Paid search: avg CPC ~$2.7, CTR ~3.2%, click-to-purchase ~3-4% (WordStream/LocaliQ-style published ranges). CPM derived = CPC x CTR x 1000. Alpha<1: limited query volume.

benchmark_basis: Paid social (Meta-style): CPM ~$10-14, CTR ~0.9%, CVR ~2% (published e-commerce ranges). Large audience, moderate saturation.
benchmark_anchor: 2025 WordStream Facebook leads: CTR 2.59%, CVR 7.72%; model uses conservative lower starting rates.

benchmark_basis: Email/CRM: effective cost per 1,000 sends incl. list growth + ESP + creative, CTR ~2-3%, click-to-purchase ~2% (Mailchimp-style ranges). Alpha low: finite list.
benchmark_anchor: Mailchimp: all-user click 2.62%, ecommerce click 1.74%; model uses 2.30% CTR and illustrative purchase CVR.
